io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.core.balance

Class BalanceService

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.core.balance.BalanceService

  • public final class BalanceService
extends java.lang.Object
    Runtime entry point for balance data. Resolves an item's final score (authored override else heuristic; trivial items excluded) and aggregates per-addon summaries live from the item registry. On-demand with a small per-addon override cache; no plugin-lifecycle wiring required.

      • warmCache

        public void warmCache()
        Pre-computes the effort + per-addon summary caches once (the heavy recipe-tree walks), so the admin installer never has to do them on the main thread when a player opens it. Call from a delayed boot task after all items have registered; safe to call again (cached calls are cheap).
